subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (Acme Retail)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (Acme Retail)

Hi Sophie,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Great discussion with the team, I wanted to capture the key takeaways and proposed next steps so we're aligned.

Quick recap (from our demo + conversation):
- Primary use case: customer support auto-triage + agent assist for high-value accounts.
- Decision criteria called out by the group: latency under 200ms p95 for web requests, SOC 2 evidence + VPC/private deployment options, predictable unit cost at peak traffic, and the ability to roll out safely (canary / fallback).
- Stakeholders:
  - Economic buyer: Liam O'Connor (Head of Product), cares about ROI and cost predictability.
  - Technical champion: Sophie Tan, owns evaluation and POC coordination.
  - Security/legal/procurement: Procurement team (cc'd) + Legal, need SOC 2 + data residency notes.

Proposed next steps (suggested timeline):
1) I'll share SOC 2 summary and a tailored pricing quote by next Thurs (3/18).
2) Acme to share any required security questionnaires / procurement terms; we'll loop in our security/compliance lead.
3) Schedule a short technical workshop (30-45m) next week with Vivek to walk POC plan and infra requirements.

Action items:
- Marissa (me): send SOC 2 summary + pricing quote (by 3/18) ,[will attach].
- Sophie: confirm procurement contact and purchasing timeline; share buying committee feedback doc.
- Vivek: prepare a POC checklist (infrastructure, sample traffic, KPIs).

Happy to jump on a quick call to run through the MAP if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0213

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary), redwood-pricing-quote-ACME-20270318.xlsx (placeholder)

From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-retail.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (Acme Retail)

Thanks Marissa, this is perfect and aligns with what we discussed internally. A few notes from the buying committee:

- Decision timeline: Committee wants to pick a vendor by end of Q1 (target 3/31).
- Must-haves: SOC 2 Type II, support for private deployment (VPC), and evidence of <200ms p95 in a production-like environment or lit benchmarks.
- Nice-to-have: built-in cost insights and token-level billing visibility; rollout capabilities (canary/A-B).

Procurement notes: please send the standard quote + any required order form templates. Our procurement contact is Dana Park (procurement@acme-retail.com). They'll also require our marketing/legal teams to review standard T&Cs, they can provide redlines after your quote.

I'm attaching a short doc with the buying committee feedback. We'd like Vivek to lead the technical workshop, can you propose 2 slots next week?

Thanks,
Sophie
Product Lead, Acme Retail

Attachment: acme-buying-committee-feedback.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Procurement <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (Acme Retail)

Hi Sophie + team,

Appreciate the clarity and timeline. A couple of notes and attachments to keep momentum:

What I attached:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, short SOC 2 Type II summary and what artifacts we can share under NDA.
- redwood-pricing-quote-ACME-20270318.xlsx, preliminary quote scoped for a 6-month POC with estimated token volume (we can iterate).

Proposed 2 workshop slots for next week (Vivek will lead):
- Tue 3/23 10:00-10:45 PT
- Wed 3/24 13:00-13:45 PT

Next contractual steps: once you confirm the preferred slot, I'll ask our contracts team to put together a standard order form + SOW for the POC. If procurement needs redlines, please send them to me and I'll coordinate legal.

Rafael, tagging you to confirm we can support the preliminary discount requested (Sophie hinted at a procurement-led target) and to prep a short concession matrix if needed.

Thanks, looking forward to the workshop.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0213

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-pricing-quote-ACME-20270318.xlsx

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (Acme Retail)
